The '''P-2 Pocket Attaché''' was a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. An improvement on the [[Pocket Secretary]] and the [[Versafunction88 datapad]], it was produced by [[MicroData Technologies/Legends|MicroData Technologies]].<ref name="LoNH" />
